answer: Triangulate every identity like a falcon timed over karst: dispersed beacons ping each agent near-simultaneously and every reply must return fast. A lone agent answers from one true place; a farm's copies share one egress, so feigning nearness to one beacon stretches the path to the others — one timber post cannot prop up two distant roofs. Speed-of-light geometry exposes copies, with no collateral and no vouching.
